definitions.overlap: Chebyshev center separation below the sum of same-army collision radii
definitions.depth: sum of collision radii minus Chebyshev center separation
definitions.frontRear: live units split into thirds by projection toward the opposing live-army centroid
definitions.tapeShotRelease: an observed attack-state episode that lasts through the sourced projectile release delay, with one raw-frame tolerance
definitions.simulationShotRelease: a newly queued ranged or stray projectile on its fired tick
definitions.simulationHit: a ranged-projectile or stray-projectile damage event
